Investors are also anticipating key economic data releases this week, including the ISM Manufacturing Index and the July nonfarm payrolls report.

predictions.reasoning: Positive sentiment from the de-escalation of U.S.-Iran tensions and anticipation of favorable economic data releases are likely to support a modest increase in SPY by the end of the day.
Apple's upcoming earnings report and overall market optimism may drive its stock price higher by the end of the day.
